title: Augtopus's Vanilla Enhancements
description: A Vanilla+  client-sided modpack with QoL changes, visual improvements and fun, helpful tweaks.
body:
# **Designed to make Minecraft more fun and immersive, while still retaining the Vanilla aesthetic!** 
**Augtopus's Vanilla Enhancements contains some visual tweaks, such as the Miniature Shaders and Advancement Plaques, as well as some optimizations and utilities, like Better F3, MiniHUD and many more. I've also kept in mind content creation, as this pack contains Camera Utils, Flashback and Better 3rd Person! And the best part? It's all client side, so you don't need to worry about whether it will work on a server!**

**_90+ mods/shaders/ressource packs included! Huge thanks to all the wonderful mod developpers who make packs like these possible._**

![Miniature shaders in the jungle with the Bare Bones ressource pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/58169f208a2da8e2160f3d19e953c907c30e3866.png)

Recommended System Requirements:
- Intel i5 processor, 10th gen+
- 12 gb RAM, 4 allocated
- GTX 1650 (for shaders)
  _Note: you can try this on a lower end system, as I've see it work, but it could lag a bit. if you are running something lower end, use the 'K' key to turn off shaders._
